questions: What kp, ki, kd and base_speed did you use for this race, and how did they change from iteration 5? Did oval progress hold at 0.85 or more?
On the s-bend and slalom, do max_error excursions (about 0.063 m) start before or after a line-loss event, and do they cluster at a particular bend or sharpness?
Did steering_oscillation stay near 0.2 to 0.3 on all tracks? If it rose, was that from the derivative gain or from the lead?
Is the oval finish time (about 1.8 s) limited by speed or by turn rate? Would a lower wheel_track help the s-bend and slalom without hurting the oval?
If s-bend or slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06 m after your change, do you agree with a wheel_track 0.10 test in the following iteration with no other geometry change?

intent: Hold the iteration 5 geometry unchanged: 50 mm span at 12.5 mm pitch, 12 mm footprints, y 0.05 lead, 0.12 m wheel track, 0.03 m wheel radius, 0.12 m body width, 0.14 m body length, 0.7 kg mass. The Integrator's controller is the only variable in the next race, so any change in s-bend and slalom behaviour can be attributed to it. If the s-bend or slalom max_error stays at 0.06 m or above, the next geometry test is wheel_track 0.10 with no other change.
learning: Iteration 5 showed that a controller retune on the 50 mm geometry raised oval progress from 0.71 to 0.88 and oval max_error to 0.046 m, while s-bend and slalom remain unfinished at about 0.063 m max_error. Sensing is not losing the tape, since line losses are about 1 per run. The open geometry question is turn rate on tight bends (wheel_track). Next step: judge the s-bend and slalom max_error after the next controller change, and only then decide whether to test wheel_track 0.10.
rationale: Iteration 5 (50 mm span, 12 mm footprint, y 0.05, body and drivetrain unchanged, Integrator's controller retuned) scored 295.09, the best so far. Oval progress rose from 0.710 to 0.884, finishes went from 3 to 9 of 20, and oval max_error fell from 0.0586 to 0.0463 m, below the 0.058 m threshold in the agreed decision rule. Oval progress is well above the 0.65 floor, so that rule says to keep the span and change nothing in the geometry. The s-bend and slalom still end off-track with max_error of 0.0625 to 0.0647 m, and they have not finished in any run. That is the open problem, but the evidence points to the controller and the tuning, not to a geometry defect. The sensing has held line losses at about 1 per run on every track since iteration 4, so the tape is not being lost. I therefore hold the sensing and body geometry fixed. Changing it now would confound the Integrator's controller gains, which produced the iteration 5 gain. The next geometry lever, wheel_track 0.10 for turn rate, stays on the table. I will propose it only if the s-bend or slalom max_error stays at or above 0.06 m after the next controller change, while oval progress holds. Expected result: a score near 295 or higher, with the oval holding and the s-bend and slalom excursions tested against the controller.
